# Initial Service Rules

- Only published sessions appear in staff search.
- A staff member cannot hold more than one place on the same session.
- A full session does not accept a normal place request.
- Manager approval is required when the coordinator marks the session as
  approval-controlled.
- A manager may approve or decline only requests from staff in that manager's
  team.
- A cancelled session cannot record attendance.
- Withdrawing an approved request releases the place.
- Coordinators may close requests after a session begins.

The organization has not decided whether full sessions should offer a waiting
list, whether approval can be delegated, or how to handle a manager change
while a request is pending.
